notes.title: Future Of Open Realms & Survey Results
notes.notes:
I would first like to thank everyone who participated in our first and second survey.  We honestly didn't think we would get as many responses as we did.  This data has been critical to us in making our decisions about how we are going to move forward and we appreciate your involvement.

Instead of detailing it all here, I've made a post on the community page at the link below.
[url=https://www.reddit.com/r/Forgequest/comments/4peezi/survey_2_results/]Results[/url]

Open Realms is a small team, and by that I mean it's just myself and Dave.  Our first game Forge Quest took us four years to develop and in that time we learned quite a bit about ourselves, the community, and also plenty about game design.  What we originally planned for our game all the way back then is very different then the game we ended up with.  We are quite proud of what we made, yet there are many ideas that have been left unexplored.

After a few months from officially releasing Forge Quest, things began to settle down and we started to come back to some of our old ideas.  We saw all the things we weren't able to do and finally had the time to begin exploring them.  However, we quickly realized although these ideas are great, they would fundamentally change Forge Quest into a completely different game.  It would be unfair of us to destroy the experience people already enjoy and we have worked so hard to create.

This is why we decided to take everything from Forge Quest and began working on it as a new title.  Set in the same world and very close to in spirit to Forge Quest, but not a direct sequel. (Unofficially we call it Forge Quest 2: The Search For More Chickens).

Without promising anything, because anything might change as we design, I will share with you where our heart is with this new project.

First and most importantly we want to make the Forge Quest experience one of an open world.  We want to achieve this is two major ways, both geographically as well as in the core of gameplay.

Our plans currently revolve around a large procedurally generated continent that will feature towns, quests, and points of interest to explore.  This will also focus on varying types of terrain that may require tools like hang gliders, grappling hooks, or mounts to traverse.

There will still be a large focus on combat and dungeons with challenges for you and your friends.  However we would also like to introduce gameplay elements that give you choices in how you play.  Things like sneaking, thievery, merchant trading, and other unique ways to interact with the world.  Our hope is to edge away from stat grinding and more towards activities that are enjoyable to play.

Last but not least, we want to feature more story and culture surrounding the land.  This may be done in quests, NPCs, towns and other significant locations. Our hope is that we can make the continent into a living and breathing place where you get to explore and learn to love.

We have a million ideas we would love to see implemented, but already the above is quite a bit of task for us to do.  (Honestly I'm stressed just writing all of this, but I know we can do it. :D)

This project has been underway actually for a few months now.  We have been exploring story writing, world building, game play design, artistic assets, just about everything under the sun.  Right now we are still focused on the core of the technology that will end up running all of our content at the end of the day.  We can leverage a lot of our previous technology and the lessons learned to make this project not take nearly as long to develop as before, but we don’t want to give out any dates or deadlines at this time.

As we move forward with developing this project we want to keep the community involved as much as possible.  Heck, we are making the game for you guys so who better to be involved.  Expect that we will be posting news here, but we are going to start moving more of our spoiler content to other sources.  We likely will end up with a development blog, however for the time being we will be using the sub-reddit at the link below.
[url=https://www.reddit.com/r/forgequest]reddit.com/r/forgequest[/url]

If you guys do have any questions about the new project, or simply want to just talk about ideas you would love to see please post on the sub-reddit for now.  We will be actively looking at it and will love to communicate directly. 

Both Dave and I thank you for everything and we are glad that you are part of the Forge Quest community.  We hope that we can continue to develop content that brings enjoyment and perhaps even a smile.

- Chase & Dave

notes.title: Release 1.56
notes.notes:
With a few extra tweaks we finally decided to release the beta features branch that we have been working on to the main branch.  Below are the most major ones of note.

[h1]Endless Dungeon[/h1]
A new gametype "Endless" is now available to all characters.  This mode allows you to endlessly travel the dungeons, without any story or overworld to get in your way.  Each level is random from the dungeon types in the game, and every 5 levels you will fight a random boss.

[h1]Monster Difficulty[/h1]
When in game, you are able to choose a monster difficulty modifier from the options menu.  This modifier affects the damage monsters both give and receive.  A great tool for players who want a little more or less difficulty to the game.

[h1]Character Balancing[/h1]
A large number of items and abilities have been modified to bring balance to some of the builds available.  You are still able to make quite powerful characters, but some strategies will take a bit more work then previously needed.

[h1]Monster Balancing[/h1]
A number of monsters have been modified to fit the game better.  Some of these being minor tweaks, but also more advanced features like combat circles, they make melee combat with a large number of melee monsters more engaging.

If you experience any issues with the game or otherwise have questions feel free to let us know here or e-mail us directly at support@forgequestrpg.com

notes.title: Beta Features - 1.55.14
notes.notes:
Another update to the beta features build.  The endless feature has been working good, so it's likely that as long  as no other issues creep up we will be soon releasing all of this to the main branch.

[h1]Changes[/h1]
- When in endless dungeon mode, down stairs will now ask if you want to go down a level or stay on the same.  If you stay on the same, it will generate a new level at the same depth and monster power.
- A new melee pursue/attack logic has been implemented.  Most melee only enemies now use this logic.  Instead of all piling in and attacking, they will engage you in a battle circle, and only a few at a time will come forward to attack you.  Most noticeable in large groups of melee enemies.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
- Fixed boss fights in story mode
- Fixed issue that prevented a lot of misc gear from dropping. From now on you should start seeing a lot of other interesting gear appear that wasn't there before.
- Shield now correctly displays big numbers in hover inspector
- Fixed, having block & interact bound to the same key will no longer interfere with entering houses/dungeons
- Fixed, dying when blocking would make the character stay in idle animation
- Fixed, default button in input prefs didn't work
- Fixed, stag beetle was doing huge amounts of damage

notes.title: Beta Branch 1.55.13 - Endless Dungeon
notes.notes:
This update to the beta branch now includes our initial implementation of the endless dungeon mode.  This mode will let you travel the dungeons endlessly, a random level being chosen each time, with a random boss on every 5th level.  You can switch back and forth from endless mode to story mode as you wish.

If you wish to check out these features you will need to opt into the beta features branch.  If you plan to do this BACK UP YOUR CHARACTERS!  To do this.
- Right-click Forge Quest in Steam and select Properties
- Go to the Local Files tab
- Select Browse Local Files
- Copy the /characters and /worlds folder to somewhere safe

Keep in mind the beta features branch is for Windows only, when the features are released they will be for all platforms.

The beta branch has been moved to "beta_features", no password required.  To access this follow these steps...
- Right-click Forge Quest in Steam and select Properties
- Go to the Betas tab
- In the drop down list, select "beta_features"
- Steam should then update you to this branch

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Endless dungeon mode added.
[*]Runes can now be combined with all colors again, however opposite colors give a smaller amount of value.
[*]King Frost Wolves no longer heal each other, only other monsters
[*]Wolf spawn caves now spawns 3 total, and goes away when done
[*]Beetle spawn now spawns 5 total, and goes away when done
[*]Armor pierce runes & perk have been buffed.
[*]Monsters now just have armor or no armor, not variable (light/med/heavy)
[*]Re-balanced monster armor, much less noticeable in earlier difficulties
[list]

notes.title: Beta Branch - For Balancing Testing
notes.notes:
[h1]Overview[/h1]
We have been working on hard on bringing balance back to the land of Shmoop.  From feedback we received we have changed items, numbers and some aspects of the game.  Before pushing these changes live, we wanted to get feedback from those uses and have put up these changes on a special build.

[h1]How To Test[/h1]
[b]This Beta is for Window only.[/b]
If you are interested in testing your more then welcome.  You will want to listen to these instructions as they will guide you through the process.

Before making any changes, back up your character and world files.  Just copy them to your desktop or other accessible location for later.  Also, cloud storage has been turned off on this version as to not conflict with your cloud storage characters.  To get to your save files...

[list]
[*]Right-click Forge Quest in Steam and select Properties
[*]Under the Local Files tab, hit the Browse Local Files button
[*]The application folder will open, from there you will see a /characters and /worlds file
[*]Copy these files somewhere safe for backup.
[/list]

Now you will want to move to the beta branch, to do so...

[list]
[*]Right-click Forge Quest in Steam and select Properties
[*]Go to the Betas tab
[*]Then from the drop down box, beta features
[*]Steam will then automatically update you to this version

notes.title: Release 1.55.0b
notes.notes:
It's been a little while since our last update, but boy is there a whole bunch of stuff here.  Most notably, cloud storage is now enabled, Nat Punchthrough will help people that can't port forward for networked game, and ability costs have become much easier to manage.

[h1]Major Additions[/h1]
[list]
[*]Cloud storage has been added.  Steam stores a copy of your save files, this allows you to automatically syncs characters between computers and in case of the local files getting deleted.
[*]NAT Punchthrough has been added.  This allows a game host to avoid having to configure their router port when someone connects in any way other then direct IP.
[/list]

[h1]Conent[/h1]
[list]
[*]New weapon, Spellbook, does only 50% damage, but adds +50% to all ability damage.
[*]Demon bow now has a charge attack.  Fires three more powerful projectiles.
[*]Demon sword now has a charge attack.  Fires a wave of demonic energy that explodes in front of you.
[*]Fireball Staff now has a faster main attack, plus a charge attack.  Charge attack is big fireball with much bigger splash area than before.
[*]New merchant that shows up in the desert overworld.  He gives you a quest to kill a demon, if completed he gives you a demon sword.  This is the first place you can see the sword in the first difficulty.  (Note: He won't show up unless you rebuild the world or start a new world)
[*]New model and animation for overworld portals.
[/list]

[h1]Mana/Rage Regeneration[/h1]
[list]
[*]Shields now increase both mana and rage when it’s held in.  The rate is the same for both at 0.75% per second.
[*]Attacking with your weapons increase both mana and rage.  However the type of weapon dictates how much it regenerates of either.  The general rule of thumb is that magic weapons regen mana, non magic weapons regen rage.
[*]Normal Weapons: Regens 0.5% Rage, 0.2% Mana
[*]Arcane Weapons: Regens 0.2% Rage, 0.5% Mana
[*]Demon Weapons: Regens 0.2% Rage, 0.2% Mana
[/list]

[h1]Abilities[/h1]
[list]
[*]Ability costs now scale off the player’s level, not the weapon you have equipped.  This removes the ability cost penalty for having a high level weapon on your character.
[*]Abilities do not increase in mana/rage costs when you put points into them.  However Dash & Leap both still decrease in cost per point.
[*]Abilities now take weapon rarity into account for ability DPS.  Keep in mind ability damage isn’t reflected in a weapon summary DPS, since that takes weapon specific bonuses into play.  Use the character summary page to accurately see your ability DPS.
[/list]

[h1]Balancing[/h1]
[list]
[*]Gold costs for combining items are now modified depending on that item’s type.
[*]Weapons: 200%
[*]Shield: 100%
[*]Bodygear: 100%
[*]Armgear: 50%
[*]Headgear: 50%
[*]Footgear: 50%
[*]Ring: 50%
[*]Like materials did already, Gold costs now increase if you are trying to forge an item above your level.
[*]Energy Bow removed.  You will still have it in your inventory, but it will no longer drop from monsters.
[*]Fireball staff now does 80% damage, but give +20% ability damage
[*]Katars now have 140% Weapon Damage
[*]Throwing Daggers now have 120% Weapon Damage
[*]Demon Bows now have 120% Weapon Damage
[*]The minimum levels in which certain weapons drop have been updated.  It is now more evenly spread out between the first 20 Levels.  Demon sword and bow can only be found in the second difficulty.
[/list]

[h1]Fixed - Major[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed bug that incorrectly determined what items to drop at high rarities.  Items of the same types were dropping much more then they should, and some items could never be obtained at higher rarities.
[*]Fixed bug that caused crashes when working with some menus.
[*]Fixed yet another bug that could happen on disconnecting from a server.
[*]Fixed bug that would cause the Mac version to crash upon quitting the application.
[/list]

[h1]Fixed - Minor[/h1]
[list]
[*]Modified a few common messages to make them more efficient for networking.  Should improve networking on laggy connections.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused a crash in the forge, along with another bug that caused odd visual values when combining items.
[*]Fixed screen fade effect when teleporting from levels.
[*]Fixed display of magical and physical damage bonuses, as they were not displaying as percents.
[*]Fixed issue where respec scroll wouldn’t show the returned points immediately.
[/list]

As always, if you have any issues with this update please let us know.  You can either post on the community pages or we recommend that you e-mail us directly at support@forgequestrpg.com.

notes.title: Release 1.54.4b
notes.notes:
This update has a whole bunch of changes.  Although the gameplay didn't change significantly, there are plenty of updates that people have been asking for.  Along with a whole bunch of bug fixes that should fix some crashes that have been experienced late

[h1]Content Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Custom cursor for the game, which should make it much easier to understand where the player is facing during play.
[*]Cursor is locked into the screen when controlling the character, making windowed mode better when in combat.
[*]Ability to scale the GUI from 100% - 200%, great for people at higher resolutions or TV screens and are sitting far away.  Scaling depends on your resolution so that the UI doesn’t go off screen.
[*]Mimic now has open animation and sound when you try and interact with it like a chest.
[*]Your minimap is now updated by you as well as your fellow players.  This should help parties that get separated.
[*]Removed way too bright background color for first primal section.
[/list]

[h1]Balancing[/h1]
[list]
[*]Rune War, Power, Edge, and Point have been modified from 10% to 5% per rune level.
[*]Monster modifications now have a higher chance depending on world difficulty, going from 5%, 10%, 15%, 20%, 25%
Much like weapons in the last update, armor stats now also scale from -25% to +25% depending on rarity.
[*]Increased visibility of fungus poison pools, also decreased the affected area.
[/list]

[h1]Fixed - Major[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed crash that would sometimes happen when exiting a game.  Either quitting or returning to the main menu.
Fixed crash that would happen when using the teleport scroll in multiplayer games.
[*]Fixed crash when you die, but your pets are still attacking people, and you press the continue button.
[*]Fixed crash in upgrade system if you didn’t have a world file to rebuild from.
[*]Fixed crash when closing the application
[*]Picking up objects such as chicken was messed up in multiplayer, the chicken would stay in place for everyone else until thrown.  This is now fixed.
[/list]

[h1]Fixed - Minor[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed UI error that would show invalid stats on items right after you modified them.  Teleporting to a new zone would fix it until it was edited again.  Now it’s just fixed from the get go.
[*]Fixed display issue in input options menu, keys 8 and 9 would show as 7 instead.
[*]Inventory weapon DPS now reflects melee/ranged buffs appropriately.
[*]Mimic and Ancient Don't don’t reset itself when knocked back.
[*]Large enemies, like Frost Wolves and Ice Elementals couldn’t travel up stairs properly, now they can.
[*]Spider outside of primal entrance is now invulnerable during the camera sequence.
[*]Input is reset when in-game focus is lost.  This prevents the player from being stuck attacking, moving, or any other repeatable action when a menu pops up.
[*]Removed ability for you to grind enemies that constantly spawn.   The first few spawns with give you experience and items, but this will stop after a few guys.
[*]Treasure chests in ice dungeon golem trap were not positioned properly.
[*]Fixed bug that prevented controller from exiting some option menus.
[*]Fixed many controller focus issues, places where controller wouldn’t do anything until you clicked with the mouse.
[/list]

[h1]Conclusion[/h1]
As always, if you experience any issues with this update or the game in general please let us know.  You can do so either by e-mail us directly at support@forgequestrpg.com or on the discussion post.

notes.title: Release 1.54.2b
notes.notes:
This update has a good mixture of both bug fixes and content additions.  It ended up being a lot larger then originally intended.  The most notable additions are weapon charge attacks and support for multiple network interfaces.

[h1]Content Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Some weapons now have charge attacks, hold in the attack key to charge, and then release once the charge effect appears.  These attacks do more damage and increase the interactiveness of weapon combat.
[*]Weapon damage numbers have been modified to assure balance.
[*]Some weapon’s basic attacks are now changed, Pistol and Alchemy Bomb
[*]Added shop and items to the chicken vendor.  Super secret way to unlock it.
[*]Added a OpenGL version checker at the beginning of the game.  This isn’t a perfect checker, but in most cases will tell you if your not able to play the game due to poor OpenGL support.  I still get many crash reports from people that are not sure why they crash, this should help inform them.
[*]Updated a bit of the in-game character menu UI.  Now has top and bottom bars and added a bunch of blue color.  Overall I think it makes the UI a bit more understandable.
[/list]

[h1]Balancing[/h1]
[list]
[*]In a previous update we added a damage increase on rarities of weapons.  We are not changing this, but we shifted the range from +0% - +50% to -25% - +25%.  This balances weapons more with the monster health algorithm.
[/list]

[h1]Fixed - Major[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added a number of extra checks for bugs in which were reported but not able to be reproduced.  Should fix a few issues, but not guaranteed for any particular issue.
[*]Fixed crash that could sometimes happen when using the dialog.
[*]Fixed crash that would be caused by pets when exiting to the main menu.
[*]Fixed memory leak, weapon objects were not deleting due to a circular reference
[*]Fixed, bug that caused crafting to cost more then it showed when in a multiplayer game.
[*]Fixed bug that allowed players who were still upgraded for the tutorial to use that character in the game by connecting to different host game.
[/list]


[h1]Fixed - Minor[/h1]
[list]
[*]Only one hover view for an item will show at a time.  Before this could be bothersome when drag equipping an item, as the hover view would stick until you moved your mouse into that item again.
[*]Fixed a number of dialogs that wouldn’t let you escape button out of.
[*]On some machines, the glLineWidth didn’t work, meaning some UI interfaces had odd looking borders.  This was most notable in the class tree views.  A workaround was added to simulate the line width correctly on these machines. 
[*]Fixed, store menus wouldn’t update player’s gold amount properly.
[/list]

[h1]Network Interfaces[/h1]

An additional configuration option is now available, you can select a preferred network adapter (listed by their IP address). For most people you won't need to touch this, but if you have multiple network interfaces such as wired AND wireless, multiple cards, or make use of VPN software like hamachi/tunngle/etc to play your games then this setting will help you.  

For example, suppose I have a local ethernet address of 192.168.1.100 and a Tunngle address of 7.104.171.150 currently active. If I wish to play a LAN game with my friend who just came over, I would want to go into the network options and be sure that it is going to use "192.168.1.100". 
Only local LAN traffic, and any forwarded by my router will reach me. But if I instead wish to play with a friend across the internet via Tunngle, I would select "7.104.171.150" as the adapter to use. 

[h1]Conclusion[/h1]
As always, if you experience any issues with this release please let us know on the forums or directly at support@forgequestrpg.com.

Forum post for bugs and discussion

notes.title: Release 1.54.1b
notes.notes:
Today's release is all about bug fixing.  There were a number of crashes that were reported and we wanted to address plus a number of minor things which have been bugging us.

The most important change in this build is we added a crash reporting feature.  This feature is currently only available for windows users.  If the game crashes, you will be prompted with a window to send a crash report.  Fill out all information you can think of in relation to that crash, what you were doing before, what might have caused it, ect...

The crash reporter will send the text you provide, plus a development crash dump to us so that we can properly debug what might have caused the issue.  This is a great leap forward, as the crash dump will let us know exactly where in code you crashed and usually allows us to solve the problem.  So we encourage anyone who experiences a crash to please use this feature!

As always, if you encounter any issues with this build please feel free to let us know.  You can contact us directly by e-mailing us at support@forgequestrpg.com, or you can least a post at the link below.

notes.title: Release 1.54b - Finally!
notes.notes:
After all the hard work we are finally switching the release candidate builds out to the main branch.  If you are still using the release candidates, please make a backup of your character before reverting back to the main branch.  You can do so using the properties dialog originally used to join the beta branch.

For people who have not been playing the release candidates I will attempt to break down the major changes.
[list]
[*]Abilities & Perks & Class Trees have been majorly updated.  Due to these changes your character will lose all abilities but will gain the skill points so you may spend them appropriately.
[*]Abilities & Perks now have have multiple points placed into them, increasing their power level.
[*]Cooldown on abilities have been removed, instead only Mana and Rage (mana for martial skills) are used.  Equipment and leveling are the main ways to gain this.
[*]The health and damage number scales have been updated, are easier at beginning levels but harsher at higher.  All numbers double every 5 levels, so keeping gear up to date is important.
[*]Increasing item levels are now done at crafting stations which can be found in the dungeons.
[*]Crafting materials can be found in gem deposits in the dungeons.
[*]Overworld completely updated.
[*]Player now has house and chest to store items.
[*]Snazzy new character creator.
[*]Simple tutorial added to beginning of the game.
[*]Beginning storyline has been changed to make more streamlined.
[/list]

As always, if you have any issues with this release please let us know.  You can do so by e-mailing us directly at support@forgequestrpg.com, or by replying to the link below.
http://steamcommunity.com/app/249950/discussions/0/610574394237452571/

[h1]Content Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added a new tab in character menu, “Appearance”.  Used for appearance only items.

notes.notes:
If you are interested in playing the release candidate, please follow the instructions at the linked article.
http://steamcommunity.com/games/249950/announcements/detail/199616928154931897

We are pleased to announced the 1.54.3b update which includes a good number of changes to the game.  The changes are detailed in the list below.

Just for reference, this should be the last update that we should be doing to the special release candidate before pushing it to the main distribution.

[h1]Content Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added special merchants (weapon/armor/trinket) to the dungeons.  They have good gear but at higher prices.
[*]Added Combine Forge and Socket Workbench to dungeons.  They are used for modifying your items.
[*]Added gem deposits and harvest nodes (match 3 game) to all dungeons, used to modify your items.  Also changed the match 3 game to give resources based on your matches.
[*]Runes no longer have EV costs, all items just equip to sockets of similar color.
[*]All item sockets have color.  Old items with no color were assigned a color at random.
[*]Rearranged the skill maps to make more sense with the skill updates we did a few updates ago.
[*]Minimap now has edges, much easier to see in dark environments
[/list]

[h1]Balancing[/h1]
[list]
[*]Rune - Keen: Critical change per level changed from 5% to 2.5%
Loot tables modified to allow greater drop chance for mythic and unique items
[*]Shops now will have a level range of gear.  However gear higher than your level will cost more.
[*]Blacksmith in town now provides a much wider selection of gear, but now has a much lower chance for rarities.
[*]Modified the Rogue - Throw Bombs ability to be a little quicker, before it was hard to hit enemies.
[*]With the addition of gems I’ve had to update the values for combining runes.  Before it was an exponential function, now it is linear.  This will make earlier levels costs more, but higher levels not cost as much
[*]Added factor that will increase the number of items needed to level up an item at the forge if the items higher than your level.  You can make items much higher level than yourself, but at a point there is diminishing returns.
[/list]

[h1]Fixed - Major[/h1]
[list]
[*]Bug that caused some drops like runes and rings to not have any stats
[*]Skeletons & Wurms no longer get reset into the ground when knocked back
[*]Some dialogs were not marking the player invulnerable, making the player able to be hurt while in talk or other UI events.
[*]Modified the ice dungeon so it’s less likely to have un-reachable areas
[*]Fixed crash when you clicked the “Start” button really fast on the character load screen
[*]No longer able to spawn multiple king dumblebees when more than one person talks with him
[*]Great Sword wasn’t doing double damage on it’s 3rd attack.  I also reduced the amount of knockback it causes, as it was making some enemies too easy to fight.  Also increased the in-action move speed.
[*]Gadgeteer flame turrets wern’t going away after 10 seconds, now they do.
[/list]

[h1]Fixed - Minor[/h1]
[list]
[*]Wurm no longer has stairs for a minimap icon
[*]Fixed UI so mini sockets view would update in inventory.  Before you would have to reload the inventory before the sockets shows correctly.
[*]Fixed bug that prevented health bar from reaching maximum.  Would stop 1 hp below the maximum, due to floating point decimals.
[*]Spider eggs are no longer attackable… Not a bug, but never really intended.
[*]Enemies, if they die in the air they will now correctly animate on the ground.  Not float and then glide down looking all sorts of broken.
[/list]

[h1]Other[/h1]
[list]
[*]Modified the background color of the second primal area to be a darker green, not so bright and annoying.
[/list]

If you have any issues, comments or questions about this update please feel free to let us know a the link below, or our e-mail support@forgequestrpg.com.

http://steamcommunity.com/app/249950/discussions/0/610574106417834978/

http://steamcommunity.com/games/249950/announcements/detail/199616928154931897

Thank you everyone who provided your input on their experiences with 1.53.1b.  We have gone through and attempted to squash every bug found, the ones we touched are recorded below.

In addition, you will also notice that the overworld looks a bit different.  This is because we are working on updating the overworld to not only use our new generation methods, but also just updating the feel of them in general.  The versions you see here are not final and will likely change.

As a result of the overworld drastically changing the one large thing to note is that portals will not be saved when you rebuild this time around.  Portals will be saved if you update again after that, but this was unfortunately something we weren't able to write a translation for.

[*]Knockback from Mage pulse, or any other area of effect abilities make enemies fly way too far.
[*]Plasma Orb will crash game on explosion.
[*]Abilities may cause odd damage numbers, like -/+ millions, due to a non-initialization of a number.
[*]Navigating skill tree can crash the game on certain skills.
[*]Health will display above maximum. This happens when a character levels and their health increases.
[*]Charging Skeleton Knight crash

notes.title: Release Canidate 1.53b (TESTERS NEEDED)
notes.notes:
We are here once again with another large update to the game, hopefully you guys are as excited as we are about it!  Dave and I have been hard at work on this one, and like 1.49 we wanted to first put this out to a test release before making the release official.  This will help us identify any bugs that we had not already caught, but also allow us to balance anything that may need tweaking as all players play the game slightly differently.

So instead of a normal release, we are going to be adding a special build of 1.53b that can optionally be downloaded to your machine.  If you wish to take a look at what is coming we encourage you to do so and let us know!  Below are instructions on how to update to this special build.

When we do the final release the full patch notes will become available.  For now the major changes here are...

[list]
[*]Abilities & Perks have all been revisited, and either tweaked or redesigned.
[*]Abilities now have no cooldown, they just consume your mana or rage.
[*]Rage has been added as the warrior's power bar.
[*]Rage can be gained by attacking with your basic weapon.  Mana can be recovered by holding up your shield.
[*]Perks & Abilities now allow you to have multiple points spent into them.  Increasing their power.
[*]Many armors have been modified, as they are the primary gear you will need to get not only armor, but also mana/rage.
[*]Health/Damage number system completely overhauled to make early and late game make more sense.
[*]Snazzy character creator which will have still get a bit more content later on.
[*]Plus many more thing which will be detailed in the later patch notes.
[/list]

[h1]CAUTION  PLEASE READ BEFORE CONTINUING!!![/h1]  Because there are so many changes, we strongly encourage that you backup your character files before updating to this special build.

[h1]BACKING UP YOUR CHARACTERS[/h1]
[list]
[*]Locate Forge Quest in your Steam library
[*]Right click Forge Quest and select properties
[*]A window will appear, in there select the "Local Files" tab and hit the "Browse Local Files..." button
[*]A OS window will open to where Forge Quest is located.  In this folder you will need to make a copy of the "characters" and "worlds" directory.  Store these copies anywhere except the Forge Quest directory.
[*]If you are on Mac, you will instead see the application package.  You can access the files above by right clicking the app and selecting "Show Package Contents" and navigating to "/Contents/Resources/".
[/list]

[h1]Updating to 1.53b[/h1]
[list]
[*]Locate Forge Quest in your Steam library
[*]Right click Forge Quest and select "Properties"
[*]In the new window, select the "Betas" tab
[*]There is a input field, put the text "owlslovebooks" without quotes and hit the "Check Code" button
[*]Steam will notify you that you have unlocked the beta.  You can then choose to update to that build using the drop down list in the same tab.
[*]If Steam doesn't automatically update the game, you can use the "Properties" -> "Local Files" -> "Verify Integrity of Game Cache" to force an update
[/list]

If you do decide to try out this build, please please let us know your thoughts either through the community discussion pages or e-mail at support@forgequestrpg.com.  We highly value your opinions on the changes we have made and want to hear from you.

We also encourage making a new character as many world content changes were done to the numbers early game that changes the experience.  Though using an old character is just as valid.

Thank you all for sticking with us being part of our community!
- Chase & Dave

notes.title: Release 1.50b Now Available
notes.notes:
[h1]Hurray![/h1]
1.50b is finally here.  This is the big update which we have been working quite hard on.  This update is so large we have actually been testing many of the changes on a separate dev branch for anyone who wanted to opt into it.  Below I will attempt to recap the most important changes that users should be aware of, however it's very likely that we have missed a few things.

Since so many changes have happened, you will need to rebuild your world as part of that.  Since many item changes have occurred, expect that your inventory might look a bit different then when you last were in game.  Most old items will stay in your inventory, but they may be less better or worse then they had been before because of old numbers.

[h1]Dungeon Overhaul[/h1]
That is right, all dungeons, Earth, Ice, Primal, and Fire have been completely re-designed.  This was possible as we updated the actual dungeon generation engine.  There is quite a bit more to experience now and we hope you enjoy the changes.

As a note, each dungeon now is split between two separate sections.  This was to give players a bit of refreshing change as they are travelling down the same dungeon, making sure their experience doesn't get stale.

As a note, there is also now a mini-boss that has been added in the earth dungeon between the two sections.

[h1]Item Drop Overhaul[/h1]
This is also a huge change that will affect users.  I will try my best to explain why we made these changes and what they are.

Previously, the item drop system worked much like Diablo or Torchlight, where items that would drop would have random properties.  We actually have moved away from this in favor of a more socket based system.  We did this because we found that in game, especially late game situations the player could become frustrated with finding an item that accurately suited their style of play.  The random properties also created a very slow pace of play, as players would constantly need to compare item they pick up which became a tedious task, especially in the old UI.  We designed this new system with those ideas in mind.

In the new system, you will still find random item of different rarities.  However one rare bow will be exactly the same as another rare bow, except for what level you found it at.  Increased rarities mean they are always better, as they will provide more sockets as well as enchantment value (read more below).

Items can now be combined with each other to increase their level.  Items can be increased to a total of 10 levels above the level they found the weapon.  This means once you find a rare or unique item, you can hold onto that item for longer periods of time without worrying about replacing it.

Sockets have changed slightly.
	- You can now add or remove runes at will.
	- Items have an enchantment value associated with them.  Each rune has an enchant cost that is required to equip.  You may not be able to use all the sockets of an item depending on the enchant value costs.
	- Items socket now have a color associated with them.  When you place a rune of a similar socket color, it will only cost half the enchantment value.  So finding the right combination is key to a powerful build.
	
Runes have also updated
	- Runes have a color associated with them.  When you place a rune of a similar socket color, it will only cost half the enchantment value.  So finding the right combination is key to a powerful build.
	- Runes can also be ungraded like items.  However runes only go from level 1-10, their property increasing each level.
	- There are now three types of rune types, which can only be equipped into certain items.  Weapon, Armor and Accessory runes.
	
As part of the changes to items, the crafting system has been removed.  The above system has replaced the main reason for the crafting system to exist, as the main function of the crafting system in previous builds were to provide certain items of a higher level then you might have found.  Since the player now has direct control over an item level it has replaced the need for it.

[h1]Shield Overahul[/h1]
Our previous shield system wasn't very good and there wasn't much use to a shield, so we decided to change that.  Previously, shield would mitigate a percent of the total damage you took, depending on it's "block value" and the monster level.  Now, when you engage your shield, all damage you would normally take goes into the shield!  The shield only has so much health however, as you will see indicated by the glowing ring around the character.  You can regen your shield's health by simply not using it, and it will regain over time.  However, If you use your shield too much and let it complete completely deplete, you will have to wait for 8-10 seconds before being able to use your shield again.

[h1]New Enemies / Updated Enemies[/h1]
As part of the dungeon changes, we have changed around a number of enemies.  Below are the new/changed enemies.

New
	- Possessed Skull
	- King frostwofl
	- Queen spider
	- Ancient Golem
	- Ancient Drone
	- Ancient Turret
	- Fire Turret

Updated
	- Ground Wurm
	- Fungus
	
[h1]GUI Overhaul[/h1]
You will notice this right from when you start the game, as we have redone almost all GUI elements.  Now the game can completely be controlled via controller or keyboard.  We have also updated the display of the inventory such that you can not only see more items on screen, but also tell more information about them.  Not only that, but you can also now drag and drop items into your equip slots, making the keyboard experience much better.
	
[h1]Lighting Engine Change[/h1]
Last but not least, we have updated the code which handles lighting in the game.  Before we used an archaic system that led to some un-desired lighting visuals, as we only stored light values every block on the ground.  We have now moved to a differed lighting system, allowing for actual per-pixel lighting of scenes and entities.  This has also allowed us to add really interesting lights to certain models that was not previously possible.
	
[h1]Final Notes[/h1]
As with any update, but especially this one, if you have any issues or encounter any problems please let us know.  Either on the community pages or our support e-mail, support@forgequestrpg.com.

Our previous shield system wasn't very good and there wasn't much use to a shield, so we decided to change that.  Previously, shield would mitigate a percent of the total damage you took, depending on it's "block value" and the monster level.  Now, when you engage your shield, all damage you would normally take goes into the shield!  The shield only has so much health however, as you will see indicated by the glowing ring around the character.  You can regen your shield's health by simply not using it, and it will regain over time.  However, If you use your shield too much and let it complete completely deplete, you will have to wait for 8-10 seconds before being able to use your shield again.

[h1]New Enemies / Updated Enemies[/h1]
As part of the dungeon changes, we have changed around a number of enemies.  Below are the new/changed enemies.

New
	- Possessed Skull
	- King frostwofl
	- Queen spider
	- Ancient Golem
	- Ancient Drone
	- Ancient Turret
	- Fire Turret

Updated
	- Ground Wurm
	- Fungus
	
[h1]GUI Overhaul[/h1]
You will notice this right from when you start the game, as we have redone almost all GUI elements.  Now the game can completely be controlled via controller or keyboard.  We have also updated the display of the inventory such that you can not only see more items on screen, but also tell more information about them.  Not only that, but you can also now drag and drop items into your equip slots, making the keyboard experience much better.
	
[h1]Lighting Engine Change[/h1]
Last but not least, we have updated the code which handles lighting in the game.  Before we used an archaic system that led to some un-desired lighting visuals, as we only stored light values every block on the ground.  We have now moved to a differed lighting system, allowing for actual per-pixel lighting of scenes and entities.  This has also allowed us to add really interesting lights to certain models that was not previously possible.
	
[h1]Final Notes[/h1]
As with any update, but especially this one, if you have any issues or encounter any problems please let us know.  Either on the community pages or our support e-mail, support@forgequestrpg.com.

notes.title: Release Canidate 1.49 (TESTERS NEEDED)
notes.notes:
Dave and I have been hard at work getting the next update out.  It's taken us this long because there is quite a bit of things that have changed since 1.48.  Including but not limited to lighting system overhaul, first dungeon overhaul, item drop & runes overhaul, completely new inventory menus, shield/blocking overhaul, new enemies, new traps, plus much more!

However, with such a large change we didn't want to drop this onto our users abruptly.  Not only will this change the experience of play quite a bit, but we still want users to test out the changes to inform us of any bugs as well as tell us how they feel about the new features.

So instead of a normal release, we are going to be adding a special build of 1.49b that can optionally be downloaded to your machine.  If you wish to take a look at what is coming we encourage you to do so and let us know!  Below are instructions on how to update to this special build.

[h1]CAUTION  PLEASE READ BEFORE CONTINUING!!![/h1]  Because there are so many changes, we strongly encourage that you backup your character files before updating to this special build.

[h1]BACKING UP YOUR CHARACTERS[/h1]
[list]
[*]Locate Forge Quest in your Steam library
[*]Right click Forge Quest and select properties
[*]A window will appear, in there select the "Local Files" tab and hit the "Browse Local Files..." button
[*]A OS window will open to where Forge Quest is located.  In this folder you will need to make a copy of the "characters" and "worlds" directory.  Store these copies anywhere except the Forge Quest directory.
[*]If you are on Mac, you will instead see the application package.  You can access the files above by right clicking the app and selecting "Show Package Contents" and navigating to "/Contents/Resources/".
[/list]

[h1]Updating to 1.49b[/h1]
[list]
[*]Locate Forge Quest in your Steam library
[*]Right click Forge Quest and select "Properties"
[*]In the new window, select the "Betas" tab
[*]There is a input field, put the text "cluckinsrules" without quotes and hit the "Check Code" button
[*]Steam will notify you that you have unlocked the beta.  You can then choose to update to that build using the drop down list in the same tab.
[*]If Steam doesn't automatically update the game, you can use the "Properties" -> "Local Files" -> "Verify Integrity of Game Cache" to force an update
[/list]

If you do decide to try out this build, please please let us know your thoughts either through the community discussion pages or e-mail at support@forgequestrpg.com.  We highly value your opinions on the changes we have made and want to hear from you.

We also encourage making a new character as many world content changes were done to the first earth dungeon, and the other dungeons have not yet been changed.  Though using an old character is just as valid.

Thank you all for sticking with us being part of our community!
- Chase & Dave

notes.title: Release 1.47b
notes.notes:
(ATTENTION: This update will require people to rebuild their world.  Many storyline and game flow have been added or modified.  You will be prompted the next time you go to load your character.)

Today's update is a fairly heavy weight one.  There are a number of features and bug fixes, but also a large potion of story content added to the game, including the final boss fight.  As an early access keep in mind that not all of this content is final, and we will be tweaking and adding to this content in future updates.  If you have any feedback on the changes please let us know in the community!

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Player revive.  While in multiplayer, when a character dies he will now go to a fainted state.  Other players have a short window to revive this player by interacting with him.  Reviving is not instant, so you may have to kill an enemy or two before returning to your friend.  Reviving only puts the player back up to half maximum health. (A few sound effects for this process are not yet complete, they will come later)
[*]Huge story update.  There are now several story points in the game that have been added which trails the progression of the game until the final boss.  We already suspect we may need to trim some of the length, a lot of that will come with player feedback.  Because of these changes, a world rebuild is required.
[*]Final Boss version 1.0.  The final boss has finally been added to the game, he is fought right after the fire dungeon and a few storyline moments.  He is being labelled as 1.0 as his mechanics and level are likely to change in future updates.  Also many of the sound effects for the battle are not yet complete, those will come in later updates.  If you have feedback about the boss fight please let us know in the forums!
[*]Achievements!  Yes they are finally here, you can find all of them along with their requirements on Steam.  It's likely we will be adding and tweaking a few of these.  If you have any comments or have any good ideas for ones you would like to see let us know.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed, crash when you would open menu while in the middle of a sword swing
[*]Fixed, error caused level up effect to show on player and pets at inappropriate times.
[*]Fixed, swamp overworld not having as many enemies as it should.
[*]Fixed, petshop merchant now lets you know if your inventory is full when giving you the pet dragon.
[*]Fixed, runes will no longer have sockets.  This was never intended.
[*]Fixed, after forging an item the component values were not being properly updated.
[*]Fixed, pilliars could sometimes obscure button puzzles.
[*]Fixed, in multiplayer, Terry could sometimes spawn multiple copies of himself when he fights you before the earth dungeon.
[/list]

If you experience any issues or simply have feedback, please contact us either on the community discussion page or via e-mail at support@forgequestrpg.com.

notes.title: Release 1.46b
notes.notes:
ATTENTION: You will be forced to rebuild your world before you can continue playing with an old character.  This is because we have made changes that require core world files to be updated.  Your character won't change, you will still have your items, exp, and the progress in the game is preserved, but the structure of the world will be updated.  As we go through the final stages of Early Access this will likely be required in the future as well.

This update is a bit longer to come out the previous, but there is plenty of work that was put into it during that time.  The major noticeable changes are the addition/change of story for Terry and the new pet system.  There have been a good number of visual updates as well and you will likely notice them as you are playing through the game.  For an exact detailed list, you can look below.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed, logic error that would allow you to fight bosses again, after already defeating them[/*]
[*]Fixed, bog that would only allow 3 buffs total to be on a player at once[/*]
[*]Not a bug per say.  The dungeon puzzle placement now uses a system to only place puzzles which have been use the most infrequently.  This will assist in preventing similar puzzles being placed next to each other.  Because of room sizes repeats can still happen. When more puzzles are built it will completely eliminate you from seeing any repeats.
[*]Fixed, Conditional mods/buffs now check on loading a character as well as when equipment is modified.  This was affecting the Mystic "Force Of Will" ability to only for the condition when equipment was modified, but not when they zoned.
[*]Fixed, Dodge value from equipment was not being applied to the character.
[*]Fixed, Monk Fistwraps and Gloves of the Raven can't be equipped
[*]Fixed, If some chicken swarm chickens are left in a boss room and the player dies and has to come back - they can crash the game.
[*]Fixed, With 100% Cooldown reduce you cant cast Spells!!!
[*]Fixed, Cooldown reduction is not visible in stats page
[*]Fixed, Creating a character with no name
[*]Fixed, Items that proc buffs on hitting or killing enemies, doing so on destructible/neutral entities
[*]Fixed, No longer gain health/mana on hit or kill when doing so on destructible/neutral entities
[*]Fixed, puzzle blocks no longer obstructed by pets.
[/list]

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Player camera now is bounded by the world bounds.  You will notice this only in town and the overworld.
[*]Levels now fade off into black, instead of using the old backgrounds.  Your world needs to be rebuild to see this effect.
[*]Updated beginning of game text.  Mostly grammar and spelling errors.
[*]Updated attack animation of the wolf/dog entities.
[*]Joystick selection is now an option in the input menu.  It will save your selection and recognize that same joystick on start up.
[*]Changed visual look of item cooldowns to have a bit more contrast.  I'm not 100% happy with it, but it's better for now.
[*]Player now has a super epic level up animation and sound.
[*]If you successfully dodge an incoming attack, "dodged" will be shown on the screen.
[/list]

[b]Storyline Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Terry Cloak has been updated, both visually and in his NPC encounters.  This is a whole new rewrite to the character.
[*]You are now required to speak with Solomon after each fight before you can go to the next dungeon.
[/list]

[b]Pet System[/b]
[list]
[*]Pets now work differently then in the past.
[*]Pets are now equipped to the power bar and can be used like an ability
[*]Pets while equipped will gain xp and levels along with you, and you do gain xp for any kills a pet makes.
[*]Pet damage will increase with their level.
[*]Pet level is now shown in the item inspection display.
[*]Only three pets can be equipped at the same time.  This will likely change later
[*]Dog pet updated
[*]Hawk pet added
[*]Pet owner now has text to teach you about the new pets and pet system.
[/list]

[b]Other Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed the types of monsters in primal/swamp overworld areas. (Honestly, swamp needs a lot of changes)
[/list]

notes.title: Release 1.45b
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce we just released version 1.45b.  As of late we have been hard at work brewing up new content for the game, story, gameplay elements as well as improvements for the game.  Only a small portion of that is coming out in this release, but there will be more to come as we implement and polish the content.

As always if you experience any issues please let us know in the community section, or at support@forgequestrpg.com.

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Push Block Puzzles - These are your classic Zelda style push block puzzle.  Much like monster trap rooms and the floor button puzzle, you will encounter them in dungeons and will need to push the blocks to the correct location to continue.  We have created a number of puzzles which increase in difficulty through the dungeons.

Keep in mind that to see the puzzle, you will need to rebuild your world.  This can be done as an option when you select your character to play.

[*]UPNP Network Routing - To improve network connectivity we have included the ability for the application to use UPNP. We have created a number of puzzles which increase in difficulty through the dungeons.

notes.title: Release 1.43b - Linux Port Now Available! Also weekend sale!
notes.notes:
[b]We are pleased to announce that with this update, Linux is now available as a download option!  As celebration we will be offering a 25% discount for the game starting on Friday and going through the weekend.[/b]

If you are an existing player and happen to have a Linux machine with Steam, please we encourage you to try it out and let us know.  We have done a good amount of testing, but testing with different hardware and Linux operating systems will really help us identify any potential issues.

[i]One known bug in Linux currently is a potential crash when maximizing the window.  This is something we have been looking into and will have a fix for in up coming releases.[/i]

This update, although the change log is small there were quite a large number of underlying changes that have improved the performance of the game overall.  Right now we are currently going through content update changes which we are excited to share.  We are revisiting a lot of our story content and implementing more, as well as finishing the final chapter to the game.  Though this will be in updates to come.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Major changes to help reduce memory leaks when changing zones.  Although not 100% fixed, it's much much better the previous versions.  This was a huge update as we finally found a suitable memory debugging application.
[*]Voxel to triangle algorithm changed, about 15% more efficient in most cases.
[*]Fixed bug that would cause projectiles/some entities not to show unless you were close to where it spawned.
[*]Method for animation changed, this fixes a few bugs where animations would cut off sword particle effects or blend incorrectly.  As a result a number of entity animations needed changed.  We still may need to change a few.
[/list]

[b]Player[/b]
[list]
[*]Now all weapons allow movement while attacking.  How fast you move depends on the individual weapon.
[*]Movement mods now work off a multiplicative system.  If you have two items/buffs that affect your movement percent, instead of added together they are multiplied.  For example, if you are slowed by a spider web for -50%, and your shield slows you down -50%, then you in total would be moving at 25% move speed, not 0% like before.
[*]Ability Pulse - Enemies are now knocked back away from the player, not in the direction of the player
[/list]

[b]Misc[/b]
[list]
[*]Shopkeepers will only show items that you can find in dungeons of your level.
[*]Fixed a number of items that would only show as level one in the forge menu.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.41b Released - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed bug that would cause animations to not play correctly in multilayer sessions.
[*]Fixed a few issues with water entering/exiting sounds.
[*]Fixed bug that would cause random sounds to occur when teleporting into a new zone.
[*]Bosses are now invulnerable during cutscene sequences
[*]Ability damage was being calculated incorrectly.  It divided damage from weapon depending on damage type, instead of using the total to calculate the abilities damage.  This has been fixed.
[*]Several abilities weren't using the right element type.  I've gone over all abilities and fixed this.
[*]Ability "Dash" caused crash.  This is fixed.
[*]Ability "Heal" now shows particle effect again.
[*]Ability "Armor Break" wasn't showing the current weapon of the player when used.  This is fixed.
[*]Weapon "Pistol" - Fixed bug, particle effect shows again.
[*]Fixed issue on Mac port that made item cooldowns not act correctly.
[*]Fixed bug that would allow you to damage physically/magically immune monsters.
[/list]

[b]Weapons[/b]
[list]
[*]New Weapon: Lance - A melee weapon with a long range.  It allows you to quickly poke enemies while keeping your distance.  This weapon has a small minimum range, so enemies close to you won't be hit.
[*]New Weapon: Boomerang - A slow firing ranged weapon.  The projectile flies out, then returns back to you.  Each projectile has the capability of hitting enemies twice.
[*]New Weapon: Katars - A short range but fast attacking melee weapon.  This weapon allows movement and is repeating, so you just hold down the attack key.
[*]New Weapon: Demon Sword - A large sword with huge attack area.  This weapon is quite likely the best overall sword, however each swing will reduce your overall armor by 1% up into -200%.  This negative affect will go away after not using the sword for 10 seconds.
[*]Battle Axes - Changed named from "Double Axe" to "Battle Axes". Changed the attack animations, now attack in 360 around player.  Also fixed so the weapon trails show again.
[*]Great Sword - Changed last attack from the sweep to a jump attack that knocks enemies back.
[*]Handgun - Attack hits all enemies again, instead of just the closest.  The range was increased, however the weapon also has a minimum range.  As a result enemies up close won't get hit.
[*]Sword Fire - Has been moved to a depreciated list.  Won't leave your inventory, but won't be found in drops and no longer craftable.
[*]Energy Bow & Magic Sword - Now does all magical damage, instead of split between the two.
[*]All bows have been moved from the standard ranged weapon 2.5 damage per level to the melee weapon 3.0 damage per level.  Since there are many ranged weapon choices, and the bow is the most difficult option, we wanted to give it a little boost.
[/list]

[b]Abilities[/b]
[list]
[*]Glaive - Previously this projectile would hit multiple times the longer it stayed around an enemy.  Unfortunately due to this and it's high damage output, this lead to the potential to abuse it with extremely large enemies such as bosses.  This has now been modified to work like the boomerang weapon, where it does damage once on shooting out, and potentially one more hit on the way back.  As a result the damage per hit has been increased to 200% weapon DPS. 
[*]Smoke Bomb - Stun chance increased from 75% to 80%
[*]Throw Weapon - Now goes through enemies, instead of only hitting the first.
[/list]

[b]Misc Balance[/b]
[list]
[*]The roll/evade now has a cool down of 1 second, as shown by the buff that now shows on screen.  This cooldown increases up to a total 3 seconds with a weight of 300.  This is another benefit gained by having light armor, as well as fixing some issues with the abuseability of the roll.
[*]Monster damage increase with difficulty setting has been modified.  It was +0% - +300%, now it's 0% - 250%.  This may need to be moved more, but I didn't want to do a huge change all at once.
[*]Floor traps moved from x6 damage to x3 damage.  This is mainly for later difficulties in which x6 almost instakills the player.
[/list]

[b]Misc[/b]
[list]
[*]Buffs on the player now show a number of stacks.
[*]Added a few new icons that were missing in the game.
[*]Updated a few abilities, who's damage types should have been different.
[*]Quickstrike gauntlets now correctly have "Heavy" tag.
[*]Standard buffs/debuffs now have specific icons
[*]Poison stacks now deal damage at the same time.  Poison damage moved from 8 ticks for 4 seconds to 6 ticks for 6 seconds.
[/list]

[b]Loot Drops[/b]
We have added minimum levels for drops of certain items.  Right now just armor and weapons are affected, in the next update we will also hit all of the accessories such as rings/runes/ect...

[b]Equipment[/b]
Unique gear drop level is equal to base + 5 levels.

Greatsword
Handgun

Magic Sword
Energy Bow

Double Axe

Critical Bow

Boomerang

notes.title: Patch 1.4b Released
notes.notes:
This update is a smaller one, right now most of our time is being spent on more content for the game that will be coming soon.  Until then this update provides a number of fixes, balances, and other small goodies.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Output file now working on the mac side
[*]Fixed bug that prevented adding starting storyline items to new characters.
[*]Weapon fast fire toggle trick/bug no longer works.
[*]Fixed throwing projectiles, aka the primal boss.  They previously weren't moving.
[*]Fixed healing ability, as it was healing too much.
[*]Generation of primal dungeons should no longer cause sections to be unreachable. (Had a small chance of happening)
[*]When attempting to forge a new item, if your inventory is full it will tell you.
[*]Fixed portal scroll gets you out of underworld (until you next login/die)
[*]When you Disassemble a stack of items only a single one is consumed rather than the entire stack.
[*]Increase quality will only improve an item so much
[*]Increase quality now should always add one magical property to all items if they can be approved. There had been an issue with order of xml loading.
[*]Many bugs with rune definitions have been fixed.
[*]Critical Bow now has a maximum modifier of +50% crit chance (at high levels)
[/list]

[b]Player[/b]
[list]
[*]Quick slots increased from 4 to 8.  This is an experimental change, which might get changed depending on the results/feedback.  We were fearful that this might over power ability, which we don't want classes to only use... however since most classes are mana limited, it should work out alight.  Warrior classes should get a buff from this, as they are not mana limited, however from everything we have seen warrior classes were weak overall and needed a buff.
[*]Potion key removed, now you can just put potions into your quick bar instead.  This counts for all consumables.  The quantity shown in the quick bar is not the specific consumable, but all of that type you have in your inventory.  If you reach zero of that item, it doesn't get removed from the quickbar, so you don't have to re-equip it once you get more.
[*]Increased player starting gold to 200
[*]Player starts with 5 health potions.  Automatically equipped to first equip slot.
[/list]

[b]Monsters Modifications[/b]
[list]
[*]This is something we have wanted to add for a long time.  This is just the initial implementation, and will likely change in ongoing updates.
[*]Added a new monster modification system.  As you adventure, you will encounter special enchanted monsters that have random modifications to them.  Some of these are extra attacks, extra health, immunity to certain damage types, ect...
[*]Magical monsters will show as a golden version of themselves.  The mods they have are displayed in the hud when you hit them.
[*]Mods current implemented are as follows.
[*]Noxious - Emits a poison cloud every so often
[*]Acid Throwing - Projects a acid ball at you.
[*]Teleporting - Periodicity will teleport to a new location.
[*]Physical Immune - Immune to physical damage
[*]Magic Immune - Immune to magic damage
[*]Regenerating - Regenerates it's health over a period of time
[*]Extra Health - Has x2 times maximum health
[/list]

[b]Public Games[/b]

An ‘unlisted’ game does not list you publicly but your friends can still connect to you via direct IP or by “Join/Invite” in the steam friends list. Once you have started your game it will attempt to connect back to you via your external ip address. If this fails your game will not be hosted publically and you will be notified via an in game message. Essentially this means if you want to host a public game then your networking will still need to be setup appropriately as if you gave people your IP address.

Players wishing to join a public game in progress simply select “Join”, select a character, select “Join public game”, and then choose any game listed as public.


[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed bug that could cause a crash on a level shutting down/teleport.  It was rare, but could happen.
[*]Kits can no longer be used on pets.
[*]Fixed purchased potions don’t work unless you exit the game and go back into the game.
[*]You can no longer use a useable item with a cost in health equal to your current health (Which would take you to 0hp)
[*]Fixed using “Increase Level” on weapons doesn’t increase their attack damage

[*]Knight: 		Melee weapon bonus +5% if primary weapon is melee 
[*]Thief: 			Ranged weapon bonus +5% if primary weapon is ranged

[*]Gadgeteer: 		Crafted weapon bonus +5%

[*]Olympian crown’s base health value has been reduced from 20 to 10.
[/list]

[b]Weapons[/b]
[list]
[*]All weapon graphics have been updated.  Most of them are larger and more visible.
[*][b]Sword[/b]
[*]Returned forward movement to sword swing.  However it is very slight.
[*]Reduced the area of attack.
[*][b]Greatsword[/b]
[*]No longer a charged attack, attacks much like normal sword
[*]Slower attack then sword, but much larger area of attack.
[*]Last attack in chain does a whirlwind like attack
[*][b]Magic Staff/Fireball Staff[/b]
[*]No longer a charged attack, attacks like other projectile weapons
[*]Added back the explosion animation, bug caused it to not be there
[/list]

[b]Monsters[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Skeleton Warrior[/b]
[*]Updated version of the original skeleton monster
[*]Now found in all dungeons
[*][b]Skeleton Archer[/b]
[*]Skeleton with a bow, only fires arrows
[*]Found in all dungeons
[*][b]Skeleton Knight[/b]
[*]Stronger version of skeleton warrior
[*]Has a very strong charge attack that he does every so often
[*]Found in all dungeons except the first

[*]Raises skeletons to fight for him

[*]Found in all dungeons except the first
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.38b
notes.notes:
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
  - Fixed crash when clicking the secondary weapon slot on character summary view.
  - Boots of the Raven, now footgear, not bodygear
  - Fixed issue where walk noise sometimes wouldn't change when entering/leaving water
  - Player is now invulnerable when in teleport menu.  Fixes bug that caused crash if player died in menu.
  - Buffs that reset their timer, now properly reset on client
  - If you fail to connect to a remote player and then decide to start a game yourself it won’t crash.
  - Fixed a crash on quitting the application
	
[b]Player Collision[/b]
  - This is a bug that some people have experienced, either them, their pet, or a monster getting knocked into the walls or dungeon water/lava.
  - A fix has been put in, that if an entity if found in one of these areas, they are teleported to the nearest valid location.
  - This should solve most of cases, but I'm not going to label this fixed without long term testing
	
[b]Difficulties[/b]
  - Added difficulties to the game, there are currently five, Normal, Intermediate, Hard, Expert, and Master.
  - Difficulties can only be played with a character if you have beat the game in the previous difficulty.
  - To start a new difficulty, use the "New Game" option on the character select screen.
  - You are restricted to joining games only of difficulties you can normally play.
	
  - The game is marked complete when the fire boss is defeated. (This will change later)  To anyone who has already beat the fire boss, you can reset him using the "/undo_event dungeon_fire_complete" command in the chat window.
	
  - Difficulties change the monster levels, as well as how hard the monsters are. (These are initial values, likely to change)
   - Normal: 			0-20 Levels  	+0% Health 		+0% Damage
   - Intermediate: 	20-40 Levels	+150% Health	+75% Damage
   - Hard:			 	40-60 Levels	+300% Health	+150% Damage
   - Expert: 			60-80 Levels	+450% Health	+225% Damage
   - Master: 			80-100 Levels	+600% Health	+300% Damage
		
[b]Steam Integration[/b]
  - Added “Invite to Game” / “Join Game”
  - If you are fully within a game you can choose the “Invite to Game” option on one of your friends. 
  - If you are currently not in a game and receive an invitation to join accepting it will start the forge quest application. You will be taken directly to a character select menu where you only need to pick a character and choose ‘Play’. You will not need to type in an IP address. If you instead hit ‘Cancel’ it will take you back to the main menu and your invitation will be cancelled.
  - If you are currently in Forge Quest at the main menu and receive an invitation to join someone’s game, accepting it will take you to the character select menu to pick a character. The behavior of ‘Play’ and ‘Cancel’ are the same as the previous case.
  - If you are already in a game of Forge Quest and receive an invitation that you wish to accept, then please exit your game and go back to the main menu before accepting the invite. If you accept it while in game nothing will happen.
  - Similar cases apply if you wish to choose “Join Game” of a friend who is already in Forge Quest. 

[b]Rogue (Balancing)[/b]
  - Dagger volly: damage increased, mana reduction, cooldown increased
  - Withering touch: poison stack now 60% chance per attack, buff duration increased, move speed reduced
  - Throw Bombs: mana reduced
		
[b]Misc[/b]
  - Hood of the Raven icon changed to placeholder
  - Added confirmation menus to exiting/quitting the game
  - The largest size of jelly is now named “Monstrous Jelly” rather than just “Jelly”
  - A few spelling and grammatical mistakes were fixed in the opening story.
  - Added another 1/2 square of spacing around dungeon entrances.
  - Moved bow projectile back, you can now hit things standing right in front of you

notes.title: Quick Patch 1.37.1b
notes.notes:
We just put out a quick patch to fix an issue with old characters and the new experience system.  Older character wouldn't look like they were gaining experience.  This was due to the difference in experience required from the old system versus the new system, it has been fixed.

A few other small changes made it into the update.

[b]Changes[/b]
- Because of new experience curve.  If a players experience is too low for their level, it will automatically be raised to the new system's amount.
- In multiplayer, experience was previously split between the players, using a slight bonus depending on number of players.  Experience is now given in full to each player as long as they are inside the same zone.
- Monster's health was upped to +50% per player in the game.
- Wizard soul perk was giving too much mana regen, that was fixed.
- Item magical stats are now shown in blue in the item inspector, so you can tell what stats are core to the item, and which are based off the item's quality.  (Each quality level increase the items base rarity by one and gives it an additional magical stat.)

notes.title: Patch 1.37b
notes.notes:
Quite a lot has changed in this patch in regards to items, crafting, and all sorts of number tweaking.  Since a lot of curves have been changed, the numbers will likely be something we fine tune in the next patches.

The nature of armor/items has changed significantly, as such a lot of old items no longer exist.  After updating and loading the game, any old items you have that are no longer are defined will not be in you inventory.  This is an unfortunate side effect, but steps like these are needed in the Early Access development process.

We are glad to be back to focusing on content for the game.    Our list of thing to do is still large, and we are taking them one step at a time between two developers.  We appreciate your patience as we continue to develop.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
	- Menus should now act better in regards to losing control.  There was an issue with the keyboard focus going to other widgets on screen, but it didn't make sense to the user experience.
	- Fixed issue where you can back out of a menu, but still have a dialog showing, causing a crash.
	- Fixed crash on quitting/going back to main menu from in game.
	- Random heart objects that randomly dropped from chests, but could not be picked up.  That has been removed.
	- Fixed a number of locations where controller/keyboard focus would be lost in the menus.

[b]Armor[/b]
	- A lot has changed with armor.  Instead of perks to wear certain types, now everyone can wear everything.
	- Equip weight has been introduced, this is weight that only affects the player if that item is equipped.
	- The player is able to equip as much weight as they like, however once over 100 weight they begin to suffer a movement speed penalty.  The penalty increases the more weight they have equipped.
	- The following equipment now all give armor: headgear, bodygear, armgear, footgear
	- Armor requirement perks have been changed to armor masteries.  They give you bonuses as long as you were are wearing armor of all one type.
 
[b]Crafting[/b]
	- Forge: Now have ability to craft items at the forge.  This requires you to disassemble an item first to learn its recipe.
	- Disassemble: You can now disassemble items, this gives you crafting resources, and its recipe if able.
	- Use Kit: This actions requires you have a crafting kit.  Kits apply a particular operation on an item, such as rerolling magical stats and increasing an items level.  Kits can be found from monster drops as well as crafted.
	- Text for blacksmith has been updated to reflect new crafting options
	
[b]Items Misc[/b]
	- Random magical properties now follow a rarity chart.  Some properties will show up more, some less.  Before they all had a similar chance.
	
[b]Chests[/b]
	- Chicken chests show up a lot less (It's funny the first time, but we want player to be excited to see a chest)
	- Chest loot drops have been greatly improved.
	
[b]Player[/b]
	- Accessory slot has been removed, but a slot for a ring has been added.
	- Experience per level has been changed, in attempt to make the player level at the same rate as monster growth.
	- Party-wide buffs such as Heal, Globe of Invulnerability, and Rallying Shout have had their ranges doubled so you don’t have to be quite as close to your friends.

notes.title: Patch 1.37b
notes.notes:
Quite a lot has changed in this patch in regards to items, crafting, and all sorts of number tweaking.  Since a lot of curves have been changed, the numbers will likely be something we fine tune in the next patches.

The nature of armor/items has changed significantly, as such a lot of old items no longer exist. This is an unfortunate side effect, but steps like these are needed in the Early Access development process.

	- Equip weight has been introduced, this is weight that only affects the player if that item is equipped.
	- The player is able to equip as much weight as they like, however once over 100 weight they begin to suffer a movement speed penalty.  The penalty increases the more weight they have equipped.
	- The following equipment now all give armor: headgear, bodygear, armgear, footgear
	- Armor requirement perks have been changed to armor masteries.  They give you bonuses as long as you were are wearing armor of all one type.
 
[b]Crafting[/b]
	- Forge: Now have ability to craft items at the forge.  This requires you to disassemble an item first to learn its recipe.
	- Disassemble: You can now disassemble items, this gives you crafting resources, and its recipe if able.

notes.title: Patch 1.35
notes.notes:
As before this patch has a mix of bug fixes and minor changes to the game.  Details are as follows.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

- Issue where players would enter a level, but they were unable to control their character and nothing would load around them.  This also sometimes appeared as a black screen only.

- Issue were monsters would not chase after the player.  If you go inside their attack range, they would attack, but if you move out they would stay in place playing the walk animation.

[b]Balancing/Features[/b]
- Armor mitigation modified
	- Monsters now only care about their level. Previous, if the player was higher level then the monster, the effective armor of that monster would be reduced.  Now it does not do that, so monsters armor should stay consistent regardless of player level.
	
	- Monster armor should feel increased, as they are now flat factors.  Light armor = 33% reduction, Medium = 66% and Heavy = 80%
	
	- Players have not changed, if they fight a monster of higher level, they need more armor, if they fight a lower level, they need less.


- Added logic that will make monsters switch targets if they are being attacked by something else.  Currently a simple system, will randomly switch it's target 10% of the time it's hit.

- Application version now displayed in window title and output file.

- Reduced gold drop chance, slightly
- Reduced misc material drop chance
	- Chances of getting potion and lockpick lowered
- Reduced monster heart chance, slightly	
- Reduced experience from all monsters by 1/5th.
- Increase skeleton damage factor from 1 to 1.5

notes.title: Release 1.33b
notes.notes:
Our focus for this release was to fix major issues that users have been experiencing.  The Mac side in particular should be much more stable then it was previously.  What has changed is detailed below.

[b]Bugs[/b]
 - Game now works off a variable time frame.  Previously it was a constant 60fps, and anyone who could not run the game this fast experienced slow play.  An FPS counter has also been added, it can be toggled from the video options.
 - Fixed bug, caused game to crash when interacting with NPC that would set a world event.  This was happening mostly on the Mac side and was making the game unplayable.
 - Fixed bug, pickup chickens sometimes caused a crash.
 - Fixed bug, unable to rebuild a world more then once.
 - Fixed bug, unable to move with heater shield. (You will need to get a new shield, old ones will be corrupted)
 - Fixed bug, audio volume resetting after going to new zone.
 - Fixed bug, doors that were already opened would sometimes not show up.

[b]Features & Balancing[/b]
 - Added cancel button to a few menus for easier navigation
 - Experience is now reduced depending on your level compared to the monster level.  Killing a monster below your level will give between %100 and %5, between 0 and 10 levels apart.
 - Meteor storm.  Attack now affects a larger area, decreased the DPS factor from %150 to %100

We appreciate your patience and your understanding and will be working to resolve the issue in a timely manner.

notes.title: Now Available on Steam Early Access - Forge Quest
notes.notes:
Forge Quest is Now Available on Steam Early Access!
Forge Quest is a dungeon crawling rpg set in a voxel world. Explore the land full of chickens on a light hearted quest to becomes heroes. Delve deep into the randomly generated dungeons to battle monsters, find treasure and upgrade your equipment. Play single player, or invite your friends to play over the internet and crawl the dungeons together.
